why: Read the grid box by box, left to right, row after row. The four patterns repeat in order: dot top-right / triangle bottom-left, then triangle top-left / dot bottom-right, then dot bottom-left / triangle top-right, then dot top-left / triangle bottom-right. After the 8th box the order starts again, so the 9th box is the first pattern: option 1.
trick: Corner-dot puzzles often move in a fixed cycle - read the boxes like text.
